처음 이 금고엔 보물보다 이름을 보관했어. 잊히지 않으려는 사람들이 왔지: This vault once kept names, not treasure. People came so they would not be forgotten.
Then people paid to forget names, too. The vault could not tell the difference.
Gammu's old keeper counted everyone coming home until the day the doors fell.
나는 팔린 기억을 먹지 않아. 다시 불릴 날까지 뿔의 등불에 매달아 두지: I never eat the memories I buy. I hang them on my antler lanterns until someone calls them again.
The voices you brought have made a new sentence. The archivist path is open.
맨 아래의 용은 탐욕을 지키는 게 아니야. 모두가 잊은 사람을 지키고 있: The dragon below does not guard greed. It protects someone everyone forgot.
그 사수는 마지막 사람이 건널 때까지 겨눴대. 마지막 사람은 끝내 오지: That archer aimed until the last person crossed. The last person never came.
돌아오지 않은 이들의 이름을 누가 불러야 할까. 그게 이 금고의 오래된: Who will speak the names of those who never returned? That is the old question of this vault.
Always leave some for the next guest. There was someone I thought would come someday.
Your tenth trail. Now I hear many voices in one lantern.
어느 결말이든 네가 가져온 이름들은 밖에서 이어질 거야. 나도 곧 그 이: Whichever ending you choose, those names continue outside. Soon I will hear their stories, too.
These stones have moved since last time. The vault must rearrange its rooms while it sleeps.
Then I will remember the door home.
여기 묻힌 발자국은 다 서두르다가 남은 거래. 수정이 울면 잠깐 멈춰 줘: These footprints are trades made in haste. Pause when the crystals ring.
Before I rush or turn back, I will check the memories I carry.
저 쇠판 아래에 누군가 자기 이름을 긁어 놨어. 소리 대신 글자라도 남기: Someone scratched a name beneath that iron plate. Words instead of a sound.
I will read it, and tread lightly.
I think something below is calling my name. We are not the only ones afraid.
Let us bring that voice home with the relic.
You closed the door. The memories that wanted to sleep can finally rest.
We did not need to follow every footprint. I will remember yours returning.
You brought their names, too. Now they can be spoken beyond these walls.
내 등불이 조금 덜 무거워졌어. 이 불빛은 놓아준 기억들이 남긴 자리인가: My lantern feels lighter. The memories we freed have left room for light.
유물 안에서 아직 돌아오지 못한 이름들이 울립니다. 어떤 약속을 가지고: Names that never returned echo inside the relic. What promise will you carry home?
Promise rest to the memories that wished to sleep.
Promise to speak forgotten names outside the vault.

Example: 5 attack defeats a 3-health enemy, leaving 2 attack.

적의 반격과 용의 숨결 피해를 받으면 먼저 소모됩니다. 남은 방어는 같은: Guard absorbs enemy counters and breath first. Remaining guard lasts this turn; it resets next turn.
Example: blocking 2 damage with 3 guard leaves 1 guard.

예: 은신 3에서 소리 2를 내면 무음이 되고 은신 1이 남습니다. 이미: Example: 3 stealth absorbs sound 2, leaving 1 stealth. Existing echoes remain.
다음 내 이동·공격·상자 열기 등의 소리에 한 번 더합니다. 그 행동 뒤: Added once to your next action sound, then spent. Stealth can absorb it. Lures do not spend it.
Example: next noise +1, base sound 2 and stealth 2 make actual sound 1.
Reveal extra medals and apply them now. An empty bag reshuffles discarded medals, never those currently being revealed.

Example: gold +2 adds 2 to your current gold.
소리는 한 행동에서 퍼지는 크기, 경계는 용이 깨어나는 누적 수치, 메아: Sound is one action's volume. Alert is accumulated dragon attention. Echo is the trace left in a room. Stealth softens new sound; it does not erase old echoes.
